en.oldText:
Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) is linked to intrusive thoughts and repetitive actions that a person performs to reduce anxiety.

OCD can show up in many ways: from occasional intrusive thoughts to repeated actions and mental rituals that take time and attention.

This condition is relatively common, and an important step is to treat your experiences with care and seek support when needed — this helps maintain quality of life and emotional wellbeing.
en.newText:

OCD symptoms can vary: from occasional intrusive thoughts to repetitive actions and mental rituals that require time and attention.

This condition is quite common, and an important step is to be mindful of your experiences and seek support when needed—this helps maintain your quality of life and mental well-being.
